ideas.pitch: A robust autonomous agent designed to ingest Norwegian company numbers, query official registers safely within rate limits, and output verified corporate JSON profiles.
ideas.problem_statement: Build an agent that finds company information online using a Norwegian company number, returning facts, source links, dates, and maintaining current profiles for at least 1,000 companies.
ideas.title: NordicScrape Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core scoring rubric by strictly enforcing source-to-fact matching, utilizing deterministic caching to stay well under the 2,000 outbound request daily limit.
